subject: Compressed QBR demo: proposed condensed windows, stakeholder rotations, and recording consent
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Compact QBR request: can we compress the demo and clarify recording policy?

Hi Marcus,

As we head into renewal, our execs have limited availability this quarter. Would Redwood be open to a condensed QBR sequence — two short, focused sessions rather than a full half-day? Ideal is something like 45 minutes for a product roadmap + 45 minutes for technical deep dive (separate days).

Two asks up front:
- We need clarity on whether demos/recordings are acceptable for our legal/privacy team (ClearLine generally avoids recordings of customer data).
- We also want a short mutual action plan showing next steps toward renewal and any required artifacts (SOC2 evidence, data retention summary).

Attached is a short note on the topics we care about. Can you propose a couple of compact windows next week?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Wu
Director, Platform Integrations
ClearLine Health

Attachments: clearline-current-infra-topics.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-30T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Compact QBR request: can we compress the demo and clarify recording policy?

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. Narrow windows are absolutely doable. Proposed approach:

- Day 1 (45m): Executive roadmap + business outcomes (Marcus + Marissa)
- Day 2 (45m): Technical deep dive + migration/ops Q&A (Monica + Sean)

We can keep both sessions focused and timeboxed. Suggested slots (Pacific time):
- Option A: Tue Dec 7, 10:00–10:45 & Wed Dec 8, 10:00–10:45
- Option B: Tue Dec 7, 15:00–15:45 & Thu Dec 9, 09:00–09:45

Recording policy: Redwood standard is to ask for explicit consent for recordings. If ClearLine prefers no recording, we will disable recording and provide a short written summary and an internal transcript that redacts any customer PII — only shared with named Redwood attendees. If you need SOC2 artifacts or an evidence bundle, we can attach a redacted compliance pack to the mutual action plan.

I've attached a first-pass condensed agenda (qbr-condensed-agenda-v1.pdf). If you're ok with the slots above, we'll send calendar invites and a brief MAP (mutual action plan) for sign-off.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: qbr-condensed-agenda-v1.pdf

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Alex Wu <alex.wu@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T08:36:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Compact QBR request: can we compress the demo and clarify recording policy?

Thanks Marcus — the proposed structure looks good. A couple quick notes from Legal/Platform:
1) ClearLine policy: no session recordings capturing customer data or screenshots with PHI. We can approve a recording only if Redwood provides a redaction plan and we sign a simple addendum.
2) Availability: Option A works best for our execs (Dec 7/Dec 8 morning).
3) Please include a short mutual action plan with clear owners and dates; we'll need SOC2 summary + list of log audit retention windows by the time we do the technical deep dive.

If you can confirm recording set to OFF and supply the MAP and SOC2 redacted pack by EOD Monday Dec 6, we can lock the slots.

—Priya
Priya Shah
VP, Platform & Compliance
ClearLine Health

> Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. Narrow windows are absolutely doable.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-12-01T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Compact QBR request: can we compress the demo and clarify recording policy?

Folks — looping in ops and CS to confirm runbook:
- Recording: agree to disable Zoom recording by default. For internal notes we'll capture a short plaintext summary (no transcript upload to shared drives) and provide a redacted compliance pack with SOC2 excerpts.
- MAP: I'll draft the mutual action plan with owners (Marcus — exec follow-up; Monica — tech readiness checklist; Sean — docs/audit pack). Target: send MAP and SOC2 redacted pack by end of day Monday (Dec 6).
- Calendar invites: I can create two timeboxed invites after Marcus confirms Option A. I'll include run-of-show and attendee expectations (no screen-sharing of PHI; bring anonymized examples).

Date: 2027-12-02T16:43:00-08:00
Subject: Confirmed: Dec 7 & Dec 8 compact QBR windows + MAP delivery

Alex/Priya — thanks for the quick coordination. Confirming Option A:
- Tue, Dec 7, 10:00–10:45 PT — Executive roadmap (Marcus, Marissa)
- Wed, Dec 8, 10:00–10:45 PT — Technical deep dive (Monica, Sean)

Recording: set to OFF for both sessions. No session recordings; Redwood will produce a short written summary and a redacted SOC2 excerpt bundle. We will not include any customer-level PHI in pre-reads or demos.

Deliverables & owners (short MAP):
- Mutual Action Plan (draft) — Marissa Cole — due EOD Mon Dec 6 — link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cQBR-agenda
- SOC2 redacted pack & audit retention notes — Sean Gallagher — due EOD Mon Dec 6
- Pre-read + condensed agenda — Marcus Lin (attached)

Attachments: calendar invites (will follow), qbr-condensed-agenda-v1.pdf, mutual-action-plan-draft.docx

If that looks good, Marissa will send calendar invites with the run-of-show and attendee list. Looking forward to the sessions.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
